questions.q: Mark and count every madd in 74:37 «لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ».
questions.a: شَآءَ muttasil 4 or 5; no other madd letters stretched (أَوْ is leen only at a stop).

questions.q: Madd audit (pupil PDF): mark every madd tabi'i and muttasil in 74:38 to 48. Today's rota group recites 74:1 to 10.
Extend: find a madd muttasil in Al-Mulk.
questions.a: For example: ٱلسَّمَآءِ or مَآءٍ (pupil gives the ayah).

questions.q: Stretch: why is muttasil obligatory but munfasil allowed different lengths?
questions.a: In muttasil the hamza is in the same word and all reciters lengthen it; in munfasil it is in the next word and reciters differ.
A) Muttasil: 4 or 5. Alif then hamza in the same word: madd muttasil.

questions.q: Think again: If a reciter stretched the same madd 2 counts in one ayah and 6 in the next, what would you notice?
questions.a: It would sound uneven; lengths must be consistent, as reciters were taught.
